description: Fetch a public web page and return clean Markdown of its main content (title, byline, excerpt, markdown). PAID via x402: 0.005 USDC on Base per successful call. Call without x_payment to get the exact x402 payment requirements; sign them with an x402 client (exact scheme, EIP-3009 USDC transferWithAuthorization) and call again with the base64 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (v2) or X-PAYMENT (v1) value in x_payment. You are only charged if extraction succeeds.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of a public web page

x_payment.description: Optional base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (v2) or X-PAYMENT (v1) payload satisfying the payment requirements
